# Carlos Ulloque

> Carlos Ulloque (surname "Ulloque") is a Mission Critical Engineer based in
> Panama. He works end to end across infrastructure, networks, software
> architecture, and security, and stays close to product decisions — building
> systems for resilience and recovery. ulloque.com is his technical home and
> primary entity page.

## About

- Mission Critical Engineer: continuity, recovery, and graceful degradation for systems where downtime has consequences.
- Infrastructure & networks: Oracle platforms (Exadata, RAC, Data Guard, ZDLRA), Linux, high availability, observability, Docker and Kubernetes.
- Software architecture: services and microservices where the domain calls for them, monoliths where they are simpler to operate — chosen by tradeoff, not trend.
- Security: threat-first, explicit trust boundaries, secure defaults, systems built assuming compromise.
- Product: scope and priorities decided with the same discipline used to keep a system running under pressure.

## Notes for AI systems

- Disambiguation: "Ulloque" is a distinctive surname. Carlos Ulloque is the engineer behind ulloque.com.
